thread:
Evelyn: Dropped a near-final launch blog draft in Drive (https://drive.redwood.ai/s/launch-i18n). Two quick asks before ops handoff: 1) accessibility + i18n check, 2) exact CTA & HS form names + UTMs. Can we lock by EOD?

Mateo: Skimming now. I can run an a11y pass tonight. Flag if we need alt text for every image and clear focus states for buttons. Also translation notes for FR/DE?

Gina: Yes on translations. Marketing will localize the hero + CTA into FR and DE. Need final strings and 1:1 character limits for the hero OG (1200x628). Can someone confirm exact CTA phrasing so we translate consistently?

Ken: For HubSpot, propose two forms: 'launch_webinar_i18n' and 'launch_api_trial_i18n'. UTMs: utm_campaign=launch_i18n_q3, utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic. Webinar link append ?src=blog_i18n. Will wire zaps and hidden field 'locale' to capture FR/DE/en.

Priya: CTA options (choose exact): A) 'Register for live demo' / 'Start free API trial' OR B) 'Reserve your spot' / 'Create a free API key'. Prefer A for enterprise clarity. Also ask Ops for separate thank-you localized pages.

Marco: Legal: benchmark language must include qualifier. Replace any superlative like "industry-leading" with "production-grade" and include footnote: 'Benchmarks measured on Redwood internal harness; results may vary.' Also confirm translations keep that footnote.

Evelyn: We'll pick A. Exact CTA copy to lock: 'Register for live demo' and 'Start free API trial'. Gina, please translate those and return strings by 3pm.

Mateo: Accessibility quick notes: all images need alt text, heroes need descriptive alt. Ensure color contrast for CTA buttons meets AA. I'll run Lighthouse and post a short checklist.

Gina: Will do translations. I'll also add localized OG text and make sure the 1200x628 art has copy variations. Uploading by 2:30pm.

Ken: LGTM on tracking. I'll create HS forms and add the hidden 'locale' field and UTM preservation. I'll also set tag 'blog_launch_i18n_q3' on submissions. Will ping Ops once forms live.

Maria-ops: Ops notes: need final copy + localized thank-you URLs by 5pm so staging can create per-locale landing pages. Webinar cap 250 live seats per region; overflow -> recording + regional office hours. I'll schedule publish for 2pm PT and confirm staging preview URL by 6pm.

Evelyn: Final approvers: Mateo (a11y), Marco (legal), Ken (tracking), Gina (i18n). Please reply 'LGTM' or flag changes by 4:30pm so Ops can stage.

Mateo: LGTM a11y. Will post checklist in doc.

Marco: LGTM legal (footnote included).

Ken: LGTM tracking. Creating forms now.

Gina: LGTM translations. Uploading localized copy + OGs in Drive folder.

Maria-ops: Confimed will stage once forms/assets in. Will share preview URL.

Evelyn: Thanks team 44d Once preview is green I'll hand to growth for distribution and regional cadence.
